AC-0060 — first-person hand: walk sway + swing at half speed — DONE

User request (2026-08-20, verbatim): "the hand / block should sway as you walk (different from the swing when you click). also the animation should be about half as fast for the swing as it is right now"

Task 1 — swing half speed (0.10 s → 0.20 s)

  • SWING_DURATION 0.1 → 0.2 (player.gd:77). LMB-hold loop unchanged: fires every cycle while held, settles on release.
  • Coupling finding: mining is press-timer only. _update_interaction advances _mine_prog += dt * mult / hard every physics tick while LMB is held on a block (player.gd:853) — the swing system never feeds it; start_mine only starts the visual swing. Attack-on-mob is per LMB press, not per swing. Conclusion: swing is purely visual for mining — halving its speed cannot change mine duration. No per-cycle rescale needed.
  • Harness (AWECRAFT_LOGIC=swing) locked to the new period: a 0.9 s hold now measures loop_cycles_0.9s = 4 (was 5 at 0.10 s; gate 3 ≤ cycles ≤ 5). All other gates byte-identical (settled/punch/tools/tier) and the interact harness is unchanged (mine still press-timer based).

Task 2 — walk sway (viewmodel bob, separate from the swing)

Hierarchy change (player.gd:354-358): a new sway_root Node3D takes the old hand_root slot (camera child at HAND_BASE_POS); hand_root (now zero local pose) is re-parented under it. Swing still writes the hand_root local transform (player.gd:621-631); sway writes the sway_root local position each frame (player.gd:651-670). The two compose additively through the parent–child chain and cannot fight. All held content (fist, block box, voxel tools, textured sprite — AC-0051) is a child of hand_root and therefore sways. New API hand_pose_offset() (player.gd:641) = composed camera-space sway+swing offset; the harness offset checks now use it (main.gd:2241/2260/2284/2296).

Drive (in _process, same tick as the swing, player.gd:123): horizontal speed is lerped in at 10/s (no pop on start/stop); while speed > 0.05 m/s the phase advances; amplitude scale = clamp(speed / 4.3, 0, 1) — exactly 0 when idle, full at walk; at sprint the phase rate is already 1.30× faster (amp clamps to full).

paramvaluewhy
SWAY_PHASE_K0.93one bob ≈ one MC step: 4.3×0.93 ≈ 4.0 bobs/s at walk, 5.6×0.93 ≈ 5.2/s at sprint
SWAY_AMP_Y0.015mid of spec 0.010–0.02; ±9 px at 0.8 m viewmodel distance — visible, not floaty
SWAY_AMP_X0.006mid of spec 0.004–0.008; L-R at half (foot) frequency: sin(π·unwrapped bobs)
SWAY_SMOOTH10/s lerpspec 8–12/s; start/stop don’t pop; idle re-converges to <1e-4 in ~0.5 s
  • y-offset = A·sin(2π·phase); x-offset = B·sin(π·unwrapped-bobs). x uses the unwrapped bob count because the wrapped phase would make sin(π·phase) never negative (x would rattle to one side only) — found + fixed during harness bring-up.
  • Flying: no special-case — sway follows horizontal speed, so flying (5.6 m/s) bobs at full rate; amplitude is small enough to read fine. GUI open: the hand stays visible under the inventory GUI (unchanged behavior), so sway continues — consistent with what’s on screen.

Headless walk gates (deterministic; the harness builds a flat 21×21 sand pad at spawn — main.gd:800-821 — and presses W for exactly 2 s): 8.31 m walked at 4.3 m/s, offsets y ±0.015 / x ±0.006 (full amplitude, both signs), 15 y-zero-crossings ≈ 2×7.8 bobs, idle 2 s → offset exactly 0.0 (early max 0.0145 is the ~0.5 s stop-decay).
